name: Design DNA (measure, extract, verify, knowledge base)
purpose: Measures palettes and motion from images and videos deterministically, builds extracted design profiles with provenance on every value (measured / inferred / subjective / prescribed / unknown), verifies renders against a profile, validates profiles and answers faceted queries over techniques, sources and profiles.
capabilities: measure: stratified sampling, farthest-point k-means, CIE76 merge, coverage; video adds cuts, shot length, static share, loudness
extract [--register]: extracted profile; bridges the reference analyst's observed/interpreted notes into inferred/subjective facts
verify: colour fidelity (mean/max dE76, dE2000 reported, coverage drift)
kb build|query|for-beat: derived keyword facets (camera, transition, typography, effects, material, lighting, composition, narrative)

compatibility.runtime: python .venv (Pillow, NumPy, jsonschema); ffmpeg for video
compatibility.notes: Reimplements the measure/verify loop of zanwei/design-dna (MIT) in Python; CIEDE2000 checked against published test vectors. Video extraction on a 15 s 720p/60 fps reference: about 10 s, 128 MB peak.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Reads media from a path you give it; writes catalogue/data/design-profiles/ (with --register) and untracked out/design-dna/. Frames and contact sheets from third-party videos stay untracked.

approval_evidence: Exercised in tests/test-creative-intelligence.py (54 tests) and on three demonstration projects on the M2 host (2026-11-02). Experimental: not promoted to approved because that requires a render-host evidence trail over more than one session.
